nom: ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including postmenopausal and patchy dry skin, describe the cream as deeply hydrating, sinking in well, and improving texture, glow, and elasticity over repeated use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, some also acne-prone or rosacea-prone, report no irritation or breakouts and describe the cream as calming, though one 3-star reviewer found it left an uncomfortable residue.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one with an oily T-zone and dry patches and one with combo oily/cystic-prone skin, describe it as fungal-acne safe, non-greasy, and versatile under makeup.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers, including postmenopausal and rosacea-prone women in their 40s-70s, report increased hydration, plumpness, softer skin, and some reduction in fine lines.
segments.oily: One reviewer with an oily T-zone found the cream kept her matte and non-greasy even in humid weather, while another with combo-oily skin needed only light layers to avoid excess richness.

concerns.aging: Several mature or aging-skin reviewers report firmer, plumper skin and reduced fine lines after consistent use, with one noting near-disappearance of forehead lines within a week and another citing evened-out skin and reduced wrinkles after four months.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe long-lasting hydration and a dewy, plump, refreshed look even in previously dehydrated or dry skin; one 3-star and one 4-star review found it insufficiently moisturizing for their needs.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or general redness report calming and soothing effects, with one specifically noting reduced redness alongside retinol use; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with compromised or reactive skin (lupus rash, persistent texture/bumps, retinoid-irritated skin) report visible healing, smoother texture, and relief from peeling and dryness.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notes shrunken pores and less redness after pairing with retinol, but no reviewer reports the product directly fading dark spots or hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some healing effect after acne, describing it as fungal-acne and cystic-acne safe; one reviewer, however, reports it caused cystic acne breakouts she had never had before.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the finish as non-greasy and lightweight even for oily or combination-oily skin, with only light layering needed in hot weather; no reviewer reports it feeling heavy or greasy.

aspects.libelle: Pills or leaves residue under makeup/sunscreen
Layers well under makeup and SPF
